page_title: ATM 3-1 GRA | Atletico Madrid v Granada CF 14/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' That's it for today, Juan Pulido has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+8' 3 - 1 What an outstanding solo effort by Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) as he weaves through the defence inside the box and rolls the ball into the back of net.
90+4' Yellow card. Cesar Azpilicueta (Atl. Madrid) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.

90+1' The cross into the penalty area from Ricard Sanchez (Granada CF) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atl. Madrid.
90' There will be a minimum of 8 min. of added time.
89' Memphis Depay (Atl. Madrid) blows a good chance to score. He collects a pass inside the box, but his effort to the middle of the goal is brilliantly blocked. Great defending!
87' Sergio Ruiz (Granada CF) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement.

82' Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) leaps highest in the penalty area to get on the end of a cross from the set piece, and he produces a promising goal-bound header towards the middle of the goal, but Andre Ferreira pulls off a comfortable save to deny him.
82' A substitution has been made. Carlos Neva goes off and Njegos Petrovic (Granada CF) comes on.
81' Bryan Zaragoza (Granada CF) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Samu.
81' Gonzalo Villar (Granada CF) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
78' Rodrigo de Paul comes off the pitch to be replaced by Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid).
77' Diego Simeone has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Saul Niguez (Atl. Madrid) replacing Antoine Griezmann.
76' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jose Callejon trots off the pitch and is replaced by Antonio Puertas (Granada CF).
74' Here is a change. Gerard Gumbau is going off and Paco Lopez gives the last tactical orders to Ricard Sanchez (Granada CF).
73' Gerard Gumbau (Granada CF) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
73' The resulting corner from Gonzalo Villar (Granada CF) is cleared.

73' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Gonzalo Villar (Granada CF), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. The ball goes out for a corner. Granada CF can continue in their attacking effort.
73' Gerard Gumbau (Granada CF) takes the corner with a short pass.
72' The ball is cleared after Gonzalo Villar (Granada CF) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The referee points to the corner flag and Granada CF will take a corner.

67' 2 - 1 Memphis Depay (Atl. Madrid) scores an incredible goal! He receives a pass, makes some space for himself and unleashes a long-range thunderbolt of a shot past the goalkeeper into the top right corner.
62' 1 - 1 Fantastic team goal! Samu (Granada CF) was set free in the area by Gonzalo Villar and fired past Jan Oblak. 1:1.
60' Memphis Depay (Atl. Madrid) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. His effort sails well wide of the right post.
59' It will be a substitution. Caglar Soyuncu (Atl. Madrid) is ready to enter the pitch as Thomas Lemar walks off.
58' We are about to witness a substitution. Gonzalo Villar (Granada CF) is replacing Oscar Melendo.
58' Diego Simeone decides to make a substitution. Alvaro Morata will be replaced by Memphis Depay (Atl. Madrid).
56' Jose Callejon (Granada CF) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.

55' Stefan Savic (Atl. Madrid) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again. Granada CF earn a free kick.
54' Gerard Gumbau (Granada CF) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
52' Cesar Azpilicueta (Atl. Madrid) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but Andre Ferreira has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
51' A lofted cross from Thomas Lemar (Atl. Madrid) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
51' Yannick Carrasco (Atl. Madrid) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.
49' Thomas Lemar (Atl. Madrid) latches onto a rebound and hits a long-range effort that flies well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Granada CF will have a goal kick.
47' What a save from Jan Oblak! Samu (Granada CF) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant stop to keep it out.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+8' Juan Pulido blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+7' Paco Lopez appears to have said too much and referee Juan Pulido comes over and theatrically shows him a yellow card.
45+7' A goal, which was scored by Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid), was disallowed due to offside.
45+6' Here comes the VAR decision. The goal is given and Atl. Madrid players have a reason to celebrate!
45+6' The Atl. Madrid players halt their celebrations as referee Juan Pulido makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
45+4' 1 - 0 Goal 1:0! Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid) taps home from close range after the rebound fell kindly into his path.
45+4' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Thomas Lemar (Atl. Madrid). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
45+3' Mario Hermoso (Atl. Madrid) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. Corner kick. Atl. Madrid will have an opportunity.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
44' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) sends a chip pass into the box, but Andre Ferreira is quickest to intercept the ball.
42' That's a clear yellow card. Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid) goes into the book.
41' Gerard Gumbau (Granada CF) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
39' Mario Hermoso (Atl. Madrid) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.

39' Jose Callejon (Granada CF) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick a few yards outside the box. The cross is good, but the goalkeeper shows himself in a good light as he leaps high to intercept the ball.
38' Stefan Savic (Atl. Madrid) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee. Granada CF are awarded a free kick.
36' Juan Pulido blows his whistle as Yannick Carrasco (Atl. Madrid) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
32' The referee blows for a cooling break.
32' Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid) starts his run too early and the referee blows for offside.
30' Thomas Lemar (Atl. Madrid) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
28' A pass from Yannick Carrasco (Atl. Madrid) is intercepted by Andre Ferreira and the move breaks down.
27' Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) brings his opponent down. Juan Pulido has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
23' Miguel Rubio (Granada CF) plants a header from the edge of the box after a nice cross from the free kick. It lacks accuracy and the ball flies well wide of the right post.
22' Thomas Lemar (Atl. Madrid) trips an opposition player and Juan Pulido signals a foul.

21' Granada CF slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.

18' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) should have done it better. He won the ball from the resulting free kick, but fired high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Granada CF.
18' Jose Callejon (Granada CF) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play.
17' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
17' Cesar Azpilicueta (Atl. Madrid) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The linesman makes the right call and Atl. Madrid will have a corner.
16' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
14' Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
12' Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid) commits a foul and Juan Pulido immediately signals a free kick.
12' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
10' Gerard Gumbau (Granada CF) picked up a yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee. He has to be careful for the remainder of the match.
10' Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
9' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) is penalised for holding. Juan Pulido signals a set piece.
7' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Koke limps off the pitch to be replaced by Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid).
6' Koke (Atl. Madrid) looks like he won’t be able to continue.

6' Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads low towards the middle of the goal, but Andre Ferreira shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
4' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Yannick Carrasco (Atl. Madrid) but poses no threat.

Granada CF will kick-off.
The match will be delayed due to minute of silence.
Today's referee will be Juan Pulido.
